closed_children.title: Gate: docs up to date (branches.json tracking)

description:
Make .agent/state/branches.json honest about unmerged branches across the exchange lifecycle.

=== What to build ===
1. On exchange spawn (task A), append an entry to branches.json: { id, kind: exchange, spawned_at, base_sha, status: open }.
2. On merge (task B), update the entry's status to merged and record merged_at + merge_sha. Or remove the entry — pick one and document.
3. On stop (§2.9, future), mark status: stopped. v0.2 doesn't need to implement stop, but the schema should not preclude it.
4. Expose an unmerged-branch-count metric (§8). For v0.2, 'expose' means it is computable from branches.json by a tool or a subcommand; a full metrics pipeline is v0.8.
5. Atomic writes (temp + rename) so the file can't be observed half-written mid-spawn.

=== Out of scope ===
- Metrics aggregation / dashboards (v0.8).
- Stop handling beyond schema-compatibility (§2.9 full path is later).
- Retention / GC of merged branches (§2.9 default 30d is later).

=== Dependencies ===
- Task A (branches exist to track).

=== Testing ===
- Unit tests for the branches.json update flow with injected filesystem.
- Integration test asserts branches.json has exactly one open entry mid-exchange and zero open entries after merge lands.
- tarpaulin --fail-under 100 green.
title: branches.json: spawn/merge tracking + unmerged count
